Marshadow
[[File:Marshadow flared up M20.png|250px]] |caption=Zenith Marshadow |caught=no |gender=Unknown |ability={{a|Technician}}{{tt|*|Games only, via event distribution}} |prevonum=802 |noevo=incap |pokemonname=Marshadow |type1=Fighting |type2=Ghost |epnum=M20 |epname=I Choose You! |current=[[Mount Tensei]] |java1=[[Kōichi Yamadera]] |enva1=[[Simona Berman]] }} '''Marshadow''' (Japanese: '''マーシャドー''' ''Marshadow'') is a major character who appeared in ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]''. Marshadow is said to be a guide from the shadows who leads those chosen by {{an|Ho-Oh}} to be the Rainbow Hero. If the [[Rainbow Wing]] given to the chosen person loses its color, Marshadow is tasked with sealing the Rainbow Wing away. ==In the movies== Marshadow was first seen emerging from the shadow of an {{p|Entei}} as it watched {{OBP|Ash Ketchum|M20|Ash}}, [[Verity]], and [[Sorrel]] rest in a cave to avoid an intense rainstorm. After his defeat at the hands of [[Cross]], Ash angrily lashed out at his friends and ran off to a forest to sulk. His frustration caused the Rainbow Wing to lose its color. Marshadow appeared and used its powers to put Ash to sleep, trapping him in a dream world where Pokémon do not exist and he went to school instead of traveling. Though Ash did not remember what Pokémon are in this world, his bond with {{AP|Pikachu}} allowed him to regain his memories and wake up. Startled by the experience, Ash apologized to Pikachu for his earlier behavior, causing the Rainbow Wing to revert to its normal state. After meeting back up with his friends, Ash informed Verity and Sorrel about the strange dream. When Ash wondered what caused the dream to happen, Marshadow emerged from its shadow, only to quickly hide back inside when it was spotted by Pikachu. Pikachu, attempting to get Marshadow to reveal itself, attacked the tree Ash was sitting by. The attempt only caused a group of {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Primeape}} to appear and attack the group in anger. Upon arriving at the Raizen Mountains, Ash and his friends traveled to [[Mount Tensei]] to meet with Ho-Oh. Shortly after arriving, the group was attacked by Cross, who challenged Ash to a battle for possession of the Rainbow Wing. At this point, Marshadow fully revealed itself to everyone in order to observe the battle. When the battle ended in Ash's victory, Cross stole the Rainbow Wing anyway and tried to summon Ho-Oh himself. Due to the wickedness in his heart, the Rainbow Wing immediately lost its color, causing the skies to turn black once Cross placed the wing on the Rainbow Rock. Angered by this, Marshadow attacked Cross and tried to seal the Rainbow Wing away, only to become corrupted by the evil tainting it. Cross tried to take the Rainbow Wing back by force, but Marshadow used its powers to take control of Cross's {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Lycanroc|Midnight Form}} {{p|Lycanroc}} and had Lycanroc attack its Trainer. Then, Marshadow took control of the other Pokémon living in the area and used them to form a small army to attack everyone. As the others battled Marshadow's army, Ash confronted Marshadow in an attempt to take back the Rainbow Wing and cleanse it of the evil tainting it. Ash and Pikachu battled Marshadow, but it proved to be too powerful and defeated them, though it is left exhausted afterwards. Marshadow's army proceeded to fire a simultaneous attack on Ash and Pikachu. Ash sacrificed himself by forcing Pikachu to return to its {{i|Poké Ball}} in order to take the full force of the attack alone. The attack caused Ash's body to disappear, and the Rainbow Wing vanished soon after. Pikachu, left in tears from Ash's sacrifice, released an extremely powerful {{m|Thunderbolt}}, sending Marshadow and its army flying. The attack turned the sky back to normal and released Marshadow and its army from the Rainbow Wing's corruption. After Ash's body was restored, he received a new Rainbow Wing. With the Rainbow Rock back to normal, Marshadow proceeded to leave. After Ash finished his battle with Ho-Oh, Marshadow watched [[Bonji]] make a speech about potential future Rainbow Heroes. ===Personality and characteristics=== As a watchful guardian, Marshadow has a mysterious personality. It prefers to observe from the shadows to see if whoever possesses the [[Rainbow Wing]] is worthy of meeting {{an|Ho-Oh}}. It tends to stay away from people or Pokémon, only letting itself be seen when it chooses to be. It never attacks owners of the Rainbow Wing unless it has been corrupted by those with selfish desires such as [[Cross]]. When corrupted by the tainted Rainbow Wing, Marshadow becomes ruthless and attacks anything in its way. Upon being freed by [[Ash's Pikachu (M20)|Pikachu]], it ceased attacking and reverted to its original personality. This Marshadow had the unique ability to control and corrupt other Pokémon when under the influence of the corrupted Rainbow Wing. It can also use [[Z-Move]]s without a Trainer and respective [[Z-Crystal]]. ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|fighting|ghost|Marshadow Shadow Ball M20.png|Using Shadow Ball}} {{anmov|ghost|Shadow Ball|M20|I Choose You!}} {{anmov|ghost|Spectral Thief|M20|I Choose You!{{tt|*|Confirmed through the use of Soul-Stealing 7-Star Strike}}}} {{anmov/f|ghost}} ====[[Z-Move]]s used==== {{anmov/h|fighting|ghost|Marshadow Soul-Stealing 7-Star Strike {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=1|1=2}} M20.png|Using Soul-Stealing 7-Star Strike

None of Pidgeot's moves are known.}} ==In the manga== ===Movie adaptations=== [[File:Marshadow M20 manga.png|thumb|220px|Marshadow in ''{{ma|I Choose You!}}'']] [[File:Zenith Marshadow M20 manga.png|thumb|left|220px|Zenith Marshadow]] ====''I Choose You!''==== Marshadow appears in {{ma|I Choose You!}}, the {{pkmn|manga}} adaptation of the [[M20|twentieth Pokémon movie]]. It was first seen emerging from an {{p|Entei}}'s shadow unnoticed while {{OBP|Ash Ketchum|M20|Ash}}, [[Verity]], and [[Sorrel]] were resting up in a cave from a rainstorm. Later, Marshadow appeared in Ash's shadow when Ash was upset at his defeat at the hands of [[Cross]]. It put Ash to sleep using its powers, trapping him in a dream world where Pokémon do not exist and he went to school instead of traveling. While Ash initially didn't remember what Pokémon were, his bond with Pikachu helped him regain his memories and he woke up. When Marshadow emerged from a tree, Ash and his friends noticed it and Pikachu used an Electric attack on Marshadow but ended up hitting the tree instead, angering a group of {{p|Primeape}}. Upon Ash's and his friends' arrival to the Raizen Mountains and then to [[Mount Tensei]], the group was attacked by Cross who challenged Ash for the [[Rainbow Wing]]. Marshadow appeared from Ash's shadow and jumped up onto a rocky area to watch the battle. After Ash won, Cross took the Rainbow Wing by force and placed it on the rainbow rock. Since the Rainbow Wing was touched by a wicked soul, it lost its color. Marshadow grabbed the tainted Rainbow Wing and surrounded itself in a black aura. As such, Marshadow became corrupted by the evil tainting it and then took control of Cross's {{p|Lycanroc}} and the [[wild Pokémon]] on the mountain. In an attempt to take back the Rainbow Wing, Ash battled Marshadow. During the battle, Marshadow changed into its Zenith form. [[Ash's Pikachu (M20)|Pikachu]] was no match for Marshadow and he ended up being defeated by it, although Marshadow got exhausted in the process and changed back into its normal form. Marshadow's army surrounded Ash and Pikachu and fired a combined attack on the two. This caused Ash to disappear since he took the force of the attack alone and the tainted Rainbow Wing to disappear as well. This saddened Pikachu to the point that he released an Electric attack on the wild Pokémon, freeing them and Marshadow from the evil tainting them. After Ash's body was restored, a new Rainbow Wing was formed in his hand and placed the Rainbow Wing on the rainbow rock. Marshadow watched as to how the rainbow was forming, signaling {{an|Ho-Oh}}'s arrival. Marshadow took its leave after everything was back to normal. Remix==== [[File:Marshadow ICYR.png|thumb|220px|Marshadow in ''[[Pocket Monsters the Movie: I Choose You! Remix]]'']] [[File: Zenith Marshadow ICYR.png|thumb|left|220px|Zenith Marshadow]] Marshadow stars in [[ICYR2]], which takes place before the events of ''I Choose You!''. In this, Marshadow appears in the [[Alola]] region, where it saved a young boy named {{OBP|Ken|ICYR}} from a gang of {{tc|Team Skull Grunt}}s lead by [[Borosue]]. As thanks, Ken takes Marshadow to a dojo previously owned by his [[Ken's grandfather|late grandfather]]. Ken begs Marshadow to protect the dojo from Borosue and his gang, as they aim on tearing it down to erect a statue of Borosue in its place. When Marshadow rejects the offer, Ken apologizes for trying to push away his responsibility onto it. After spending the night with Ken and the Pokémon living at the dojo, Marshadow gets up and runs off to the hideout of Borosue and his gang, where it challenges them to a battle. When Ken arrives at the hideout, he finds that Marshadow managed to defeat the Grunts and all of their Pokémon. Borosue, noting that fighting over a hundred Pokémon would leave it exhausted, sends out a {{p|Gyarados}} to attack Marshadow. The tired Gloomdweller Pokémon is nearly defeated, but Ken steps in to defend it. Marshadow, impressed by Ken's courage despite knowing he has no chance of victory, hands Ken a [[Marshadium Z]] to put in the [[Z-Ring|Hero's Ring]] he received from his grandfather. With the Z-Crystal, Ken has Marshadow activate {{m|Soul-Stealing 7-Star Strike}}, easily defeating Borosue's Gyarados. The next day, Ken thanks Marshadow for helping him become more courageous. As Marshadow leaves, Ken promises to get stronger and become a Trainer strong enough to protect the dojo. =====Moves used===== {{anmov/h|fighting|ghost|}} {{anmov|ghost|Spectral Thief|ICYR2|ICYR2{{tt|*|Confirmed through the use of Soul-Stealing 7-Star Strike}}}} {{anmov/f|ghost}} ======[[Z-Move]]s used====== {{anmov/h|fighting|ghost|Marshadow Soul Stealing 7 Star Strike ICYR.png|Using Soul-Stealing 7-Star Strike}} {{anmov|ghost|Soul-Stealing 7-Star Strike|ICYR2|ICYR2{{tt|*|Base move is Spectral Thief}}}} {{anmov/f|ghost}} ==In the games== This Marshadow was distributed to players of {{g|Sun and Moon}} and {{pkmn|Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon}} who inserted a serial code, which was included on preordered tickets for ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]'' in Japan, Singapore, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and South Korea.
